sources.title: hoshimachi_suisei_(school_uniform)
sources.excerpt:
The 4th [[official alternate costume|costume]] of [[hololive]]'s [[Hoshimachi Suisei]].

It's a [[school uniform]]-themed outift and comes in 2 versions:
* A [[white dress|white]] [[sailor dress]] consisting of a [[grey cardigan|grey]] [[aran sweater|aran cardigan]], a [[blue choker]], a [[white sailor collar]], a [[blue bowtie]] and a [[blue belt]].
* A [[black dress|black]] [[sailor dress]] consisting of a [[white jacket|white]] [[hooded jacket]] with [[cat hood|cat ears]], a [[black choker]], a [[black sailor collar]], a [[yellow bowtie]] and a [[grey belt]].

In both versions the shirt has [[frilled sleeves|frilled]] [[puffy short sleeves]], a [[star brooch]] holding the bowtie, the dress is a [[pleated dress|pleated]] [[medium dress|knee-lenght]] [[half-dress]], and both have [[white socks]] and [[black footwear|black]] [[loafers]], she also wears [[pearl earrings]] on both versions.

Her [[official alternate hairstyle|official hairstyle]] with this outfit is [[long hair]] in a [[half updo]] with a [[single side bun|single]] [[side up bun]].

h4. Appearance
